The '''Battle of Garqi''' was a battle in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Prelude==
Going on a reconnaissance mission to [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], a [[Yuuzhan Vong]]-[[Invasion of Garqi|controlled]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Ganner Rhysode]], and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] arrived in the ''[[Lost Hope]]'', a frigate that was rigged to explode. They, along with six [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] entered the [[Best Chance (shuttle)|''Best Chance'']], a smaller vehicle inside the ''Lost Hope''. The ''Lost Hope'' exploded above Garqi, raining debris, including the ''Best Chance'', which was supposed to look like a piece of debris. The ''Best Chance'' made it to the planet, where the Jedi met up with [[Resistance (Garqi)|resistance fighters]] against the Yuuzhan Vong.

==The battle==
The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Noghri waited in underground tunnels beneath a plaza in the [[Wlesc]] neighborhood where the Yuuzhan Vong forces were assembling, and used their [[holovision goggles]] to get a better view of the streets. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], called [[Thrall]], then ambushed the Yuuzhan Vong force, and the battle started. The Noghri started to slice through the Chazrach, while the Jedi faced the Yuuzhan Vong warriors. Ganner Rhysode killed the first Yuuzhan Vong warrior, but another issued a command to the slaves, Human and Chazrach, which turned to face the Jedi.

The Jedi started slaughtering the slaves, and Corran Horn managed to kill the lead warrior, while focused [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] fire from resistance fighters killed the third. The Jedi then escaped to the nearby [[Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden]], where [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Bafforr tree]]s were [[Ithorian section|housed]]. The Yuuzhan Vong entered the Garden. The leader warrior, named [[Krag Val]], challenged Corran, but Ganner stood in front of him, and the Noghri [[Mushkil]] stood in front of Ganner, although the Noghri was killed. Ganner then attempted to engage the Yuuzhan Vong leader, but Krag Val's [[amphistaff]] came down, and left a huge gash on Ganner's face.

Jacen Solo engaged Krag Val, and managed to temporarily disable him until Corran Horn came. But by the time Corran engaged the warriors, their armor had gone under an allergic reaction to the Bafforr tree pollen, and suffocated the warriors. Samples were taken of the pollen, and the garden was burned, along with the warriors. The Jedi and Noghri returned to the ''Best Chance'', and the resistance fighters chose to stay behind.

The ''[[Ralroost]]'' arrived in system with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], one of the pilots being [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. Their plan was to pick up the ''Best Chance'', but a huge Yuuzhan Vong force arrived in the area. Rogue Squadron fought the [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]], but the ''Best Chance'' was being overrun. At that time, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] arrived in-system with the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. The [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|Chiss Clawcraft]] engaged and overran the coralskippers, while the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] engaged the enemy capital ships, destroying a Yuuzhan Vong corvette. This gave the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] time to flee, along with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] forces and a large [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] fleet.
